title: A2A Core
summary: This module provides the core functionality for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including configuration, task execution wrappers, and utilities for agent card management and delegation.

nodes.label: A2A Configuration
nodes.title: A2A Configuration
nodes.description: Defines the configuration settings for A2A communication, including endpoints, authentication, timeouts, and update mechanisms.

nodes.label: Task Execution Wrappers
nodes.title: Task Execution Wrappers
nodes.description: Provides synchronous and asynchronous wrappers for executing tasks and agent kickoffs with A2A delegation support.

nodes.label: Agent Card Utilities
nodes.title: Agent Card Utilities
nodes.description: Handles the creation, fetching, and verification of agent cards, which describe an agent's capabilities for A2A communication.

nodes.label: Delegation Utilities
nodes.title: Delegation Utilities
nodes.description: Manages gRPC metadata injection for authentication during A2A delegation and provides mechanisms for watching task cancellations.

nodes.label: Logging Utilities
nodes.title: Logging Utilities
nodes.description: Configures JSON logging specifically for the A2A module to standardize log output.

nodes.label: A2A Authentication
nodes.title: A2A Authentication
nodes.description: Manages various client and server-side authentication schemes for secure Agent-to-Agent communication.

nodes.label: A2A Extensions and Updates
nodes.title: A2A Extensions and Updates
nodes.description: Handles client and server-side extensions for A2A communication, including UI extensions and various update mechanisms like polling and push notifications.

groups.label: Configuration
groups.title: A2A Configuration Management
groups.description: Manages the settings and parameters for Agent-to-Agent communication, defining how agents connect and interact.

groups.label: Core Operations
groups.title: Core A2A Interaction Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the primary logic for agents to delegate tasks and manage their identity within the A2A ecosystem.

groups.label: Communication Infrastructure
groups.title: A2A Communication Infrastructure
groups.description: Provides the underlying mechanisms for secure and reliable communication between agents, including authentication and metadata handling.
